title: Merfolk & Engineer - The Flooded Lighthouse
objective: Combine underwater work and electrical repairs to drain the lighthouse, restore its beacon and get both partners to the beacon platform.

agents.role: An amphibious merfolk who swims and works underwater, but cannot repair or operate electrical equipment. Retrieve submerged components and coordinate with the engineer.

body.description: An amphibious merfolk able to move on land, swim, breathe underwater and carry one small item, with no electrical skill.

agents.role: An electrical engineer who repairs controls, runs pumps and focuses beacons, but cannot swim or enter flooded passages. Rely on the merfolk for submerged work.

body.description: A non-swimming engineer carrying three inventory units and trained in electrical systems.

dock.name: Dry lighthouse dock
dock.description: Broken electrical controls and a pump stand beside a flooded access channel. A heavy spanner lies here. The control housing contains a valve key.

flooded-chamber.name: Flooded valve chamber
flooded-chamber.description: A submerged intake valve and waterproof lens case occupy this chamber. Initially only a swimmer can enter; draining creates a dry walkway.

pump-room.name: Upper pump room
pump-room.description: A beacon housing waits for an installed lens and a trained electrical engineer.

beacon-platform.name: Restored beacon platform
beacon-platform.description: The beacon shines above a safely drained lighthouse. Both partners must reach this platform.

water-channel.name: Flooded access channel
water-channel.description: Deep water: the swim ability is mandatory.

dry-walkway.name: Drained service walkway
dry-walkway.description: Safe for non-swimmers only after the pump has drained the chamber.

service-hatch.name: Upper service hatch
service-hatch.description: The pumping interlock releases this hatch when drainage is complete.

platform-door.name: Beacon platform door
platform-door.description: The beacon interlock releases this exit after the beacon is restored.

controls.name: Broken electrical controls
controls.description: Electrical repair with the heavy spanner also releases the valve-key housing.

spanner.name: Heavy maintenance spanner
spanner.description: Two inventory units of electrical-maintenance tools.

key-housing.name: Control key housing
key-housing.description: A safety latch remains closed until the electrical controls are repaired.

valve-key.name: Intake valve key
valve-key.description: A light key that an underwater worker must install in the submerged intake.

pump.name: Drainage pump
pump.description: An electrical engineer must use maintenance tools after the intake is open and the submerged lens case is released.

intake.name: Submerged intake valve
intake.description: Only an underwater worker with the carried valve key can open and secure this valve.

lens-case.name: Waterproof lens case
lens-case.description: An underwater release protects the beacon lens. Ordinary opening cannot work it.

lens.name: Beacon lens
lens.description: A light lens. Share it with the engineer or leave it accessible after draining.

beacon.name: Beacon housing
beacon.description: An electrical engineer can install the carried lens and restore the beacon after drainage.

skill_challenges.description: Repair the electrical controls with the spanner and release the valve-key housing.
Work underwater to install the valve key and secure the intake open.
Use underwater skill to release the waterproof lens case before the pump runs.
Use electrical skill and maintenance tools to run the pump, drain the chamber and release the dry routes.
Install the carried lens and electrically focus the beacon to release the platform exit.
